problem_type: Whether a paid generation asks for confirmation was decided per entry, and the initiator was lost before the decision
symptom: User 2026-09-25: every click on a single node's generate button opens 「开始生成 · 将生成 1 段视频 · 预计约 1 分钟 · 会消耗模型额度 · 预计金额 目录未标价 · 取消 / 生成」. Real-machine reproduction on origin/main d8824a0c5: one ↑ click, one dialog, a second click on 生成 to actually start.
direct_cause: confirmGenerationSpend always called requestConfirm except when every node ran on local ComfyUI; the cost was only visible inside the dialog. Storyboard execution set gesture.source='agent' for Agent-driven runs but never passed it to confirmAndRunNode / confirmAndRunPlan / confirmGenerationSpend.
class_root: No single predicate owned 'does this paid run need a human confirmation'; entries decided by whether they called the funnel, and the facts the decision needs (initiator, run count, quote) did not reach it.
affected_population: Every user-initiated single generation (composer ↑, result regenerate, error retry, storyboard row, Ctrl+Enter single selection, task center retry, timeline regenerate)

invariant_owner_layer.why: spendConfirmationRequirement is the only predicate and confirmGenerationSpend its only caller; the policy test sweeps every combination and the funnel tests prove quotes still reach the grant when no dialog is shown.

entry_points: confirmAndRunNode / confirmAndRunNodeVariants / regenerateNodeInPlace (single node, variants, regenerate)
confirmAndRunPlan via confirmAndMintGrant (batch, Ctrl+Enter, frame, shot table, pending references)
Storyboard row / anchor actions (user or Agent gesture)
internal_only_reason: The confirmation policy is a product decision recorded on 2026-09-25 (single node no dialog, ≥2 runs / ≥10 credits / Agent / hosting disclosure / missing quote confirm); no external specification governs it. The main-process quote-bound grant (electron/spendGrant.ts) is unchanged and still enforces that every paid submission consumes a current quote.
invariants: Whether to show the spend confirmation is decided only by spendConfirmationRequirement from (initiator, run count, quote amount, hosting disclosure)
Agent-initiated paid runs always confirm; runs without a quote always confirm
Runs that skip the dialog still obtain a quote and mint the grant with its quoteId

initiator is required on every link of the chain (confirmGenerationSpend, confirmAndMintGrant, confirmAndRunNode / confirmAndRunNodeVariants / regenerateNodeInPlace, confirmAndRunPlan) with no default; storyboard row actions take either a gesture (its source derives the initiator) or an explicit initiator, never neither and never both

door_reduction.why_not: The three funnels stay because they carry different run shapes (single / variants / regenerate in the runner, batch plans in batchPlanPreview, the predicate owner in spendConfirm); none of them decides anymore — they report initiator and run count and the predicate decides.

generality_proof: The decision moved from 'which entry called the funnel' to a predicate over facts every entry reports, so a new entry cannot opt out or in by accident; the Agent initiator is carried in GenerationConfirmationGuards, which every confirm function already accepts. The initiator is a required field with no default anywhere on the chain, so a new entry that forgets it does not compile (spendInitiatorRequired.test.ts pins each link with @ts-expect-error; making it optional turns check:test-types red with TS2578).

shared_boundaries.responsibility: The only rule for whether a paid run asks first

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Reports initiator from gesture.source (non-user → agent); storyboardBatchLanding.test.ts asserts user and agent are reported
Goes through confirmAndMintGrant whose nodes are now required; a single user run follows the same predicate
Different host decided by capabilityApprovalPolicy.spendDecidedByPolicy in the main process; unchanged

recurrence.reason: Any new generation entry (there are 15+) would otherwise decide on its own whether to confirm, and the Agent initiator had already been lost once.

prevention.invariant: Confirmation is required iff agent-initiated, ≥2 runs, quote ≥ SINGLE_RUN_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD_CREDITS, hosting disclosure, or no quote
prevention.failure_mode: No quote → the dialog is shown; declining never transfers the quote id
prevention.strategy: One pure predicate called only by the funnel; entries report facts; initiator threaded through the existing guard type

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed the implicit 'always confirm unless ComfyUI' behaviour and the optional nodes fallback in confirmAndMintGrant (nodes are now required, so a caller cannot silently turn the decision into 'unknown vendor')

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Pure product policy in the renderer; the main-process quote/grant contract is unchanged

migration: No persisted state. The threshold is a constant (no setting existed; 2026-09-09 removed the hard budget).
residual_risks: A mis-click on ↑ now spends up to the threshold without a second step; providers have no cancel API. Mitigated by the always-visible cost next to ↑ and the threshold, as the user accepted
The renderer cost chip matches catalog rows case-insensitively while the main-process quote matches exactly; the dialog decision uses the main-process quote
